definitions.explanation: A particular part of a country, city, or larger geographical area.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{安全|あんぜん}だ。
{地域|ちいき}の{人|ひと}たちと{交流|こうりゅう}している。
examples.english: I interact with people in the community.

notes: Can refer to geographic regions or local communities. Related: {地域社会|ちいきしゃかい} (local community).
